text:
alex: Quick standup — release train check-in.
What I did: validated canary for model-route v2 on Dedicated, ran smoke tests (all green).
Cherry-picks: opened PR #5123 to backport config -> stable.
Blockers: CI flaky on ubuntu-22 runners for gpu-operator integration (seen 1/3 flakes).
Today: re-run failing CI, try backport merge, coordinate with infra.

jamie: I can reproduce the flaky readiness locally, looks like a timing window in the liveness probe. Will add extra debug logs.

priya: re: #5123 — can you add the backport label? I can merge once CI is green.

liam: heads-up: autoscaler saw a short spike during the canary, no user impact, but I'm throttling non-critical merges for the next 30m.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for train-2247 -> region us-west1 (5%) :rocket:

alex: thanks. @liam holding merges. @jamie drop repro steps here so I can try a local run too.

jamie: repro steps:
```
# reproduce flaky readiness locally
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/runner -c health --tail=200
kubectl port-forward svc/runner 8080:8080 &
curl -sS http://localhost:8080/health
pytest tests/test_gpu_operator.py::test_ready -k readiness -q
```

priya: added label `backport/stable` to #5123. ping me when CI passes and I'll do the merge.

liam: small ask — please don't cherry-pick the experimental quant change (PR #5199) into the stable train. Need perf validation on 8k token runs first.

alex: noted, experimental stays out of this train. Anyone available for kernel-select follow-up today? @jamie?

jamie: I can be on call after 16:00 PT, will keep digging and post logs here.

deploy-bot: canary progressed to 25% — waiting on healthchecks before wider rollout.

alex: OK. I'll re-run CI at ~14:20 PT, update this thread with status. Thanks all :thumbsup:
